name: Buff-spotted Flameback
extract: The buff-spotted flameback (Chrysocolaptes lucidus) is a species of bird in the family Picidae. It is found on the  Philippine islands of Bohol, Leyte, Samar, Biliran, Panaon, Mindanao, Basilan, and Samal. Along with the other Philippine species, Yellow-faced flameback, Luzon flameback, Red-headed flameback, it was formerly conspecific greater flameback
